fix(daemon): one owner says whether the OS is delivering file events, and an edit made while it wasn't reloads when they resume (brandon-unfiled-3248.y66h) (#485)

* fix(daemon): one owner says whether the OS is delivering file events, and an edit made while it wasn't reloads when they resume (brandon-unfiled-3248.y66h)

The daemon writes a probe into a folder of its own each period and judges
delivery for every watch it holds: delivering, stalled, or unmeasured with a
reason. A stall or an unmeasured span draws an amber row naming the span's
start, daemon-stats prints a fileEvents line, and the span's close reloads
every config entry under events-resumed and re-reads every held plugin file.
Plugin storage reads that one owner in place of a probe per folder, and keeps
judging each folder's identity on the owner's period.

* fix(daemon): a catch-up re-reads watch_file sources, and the row stands while the span is open (brandon-unfiled-3248.y66h)

A `watch_file` source watches through its directory on the same OS stream
the probe tests, so a stall silenced it too, and nothing re-read it when
events resumed. Every registry now subscribes to the delivery owner's
catch-ups, and a catch-up fires each watched file's subscribers as its own
watch would have.

The bar's row and daemon-stats' line derive from the unvouched span, not
the state's label: a probe that landed after a stall is not one heard, so
delivering with the span open still warns, and the stats line names the
span's start in every state.

The causes that reload every entry are their own type, so a single entry's
cause cannot be batched.
fix(config): an insert cell warns only where a config file wrote the tree it missed (candybar-plugins-vf6g.99v)
fix(config): every rendered tree places a layer's insert cells, so presets decide their own anchors and clashes (candybar-plugins-vf6g.99v)
feat(config): a repo config can add a cell beside a placement the user already has (candybar-plugins-vf6g.99v)
